cells.gaps: One locality, Sinja in Sennar State, is named: one of two model sites where Isali electronic collection was launched on 12 May 2026. Whether collection there ran past the model stage, or reached the other localities the state said it would cover from the second half of 2026, is not established. No register of payers is stated, nor where the record is held, and no plan or finance has been found. In the other states holding Isali no locality is named as live.
cells.note: A locality launched as a model site is a pilot. Stage 3 needs a system past its pilot and live in localities outside the capital, and no fact dated after the launch says so.
